excludedRepositoryLanguages.yaml: Shiki/JS cannot translate the current multi-codepoint hex escape.
excludedRepositoryLanguages.sql: Shiki/JS differs from native/WASM on the SQL fixture in a fresh isolated process. Excluded from every engine in this shared memory cohort.

method.engineOrder: Serial fresh processes; rotate engines once per repetition, separately per scenario.
method.baseline: Inputs loaded; two explicit V8 collections before engine-specific imports.
method.checkpoints: After initialization and passes 1/10/50 (repository) or 1/5/10 (large TypeScript). Two explicit V8 collections at each checkpoint; no forced GC between documents.
method.output: Consume UTF-8 HTML byte length and discard each result. Exact HTML SHA-256 agreement is checked in separate validation processes before measuring.
method.peak: OS process-lifetime high-water RSS through the final render checkpoint, in bytes (Node maxRSS KiB multiplied by 1024). Includes startup, inputs, imports, setup, rendering and explicit GC; no baseline subtraction.
method.limits: RSS includes the Node runtime, native code, WASM and allocator retention. V8 heap/external/ArrayBuffer fields are diagnostic subsets, not native allocation counters. Forced GC does not force native allocators or WASM to return pages to the OS. Fixed sequential workloads are not a leak, concurrency or capacity test. Compare within a host, not across operating systems.
